notes: Cloudera's careers page reaches the Workday CXS site External_Career. Search is POST https://cloudera.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/cloudera/External_Career/jobs with {appliedFacets, limit, offset, searchText}; the returned facets are exactly remoteType, Business_Area, locationMainGroup>locationCountry and distance (no job-family or time-type facet). The unfiltered response is already newest-first (Posted Today, Today, 3 Days Ago ...); adding sortBy=postedOn returned HTTP 200 with an identical order, so no distinct sort control is claimed.
